attribution_holdouts.description: IB-rt-7 (CTO ruling 3(b)+7, row C-S75): the attribution holdouts. OPTIONAL by the v1 immutability rule -- its presence is enforced by the producer and the battery, never by invalidating a v1 document that predates it. THE HOLDOUTS. An account the custody feed carries and the overlay feed does not is VISIBLE here with its full custody value -- never redistributed into the sleeves that do have an assignment, and never dropped. security_aggregates.description: ADDITIVE, OPTIONAL (CTO DECISION 103025, walk-2 state table row W2-11: "the server serves the aggregate" -- a portal fold is not legal). One item per distinct security identity (security_id) among the ACTUAL positions of THIS document's scope -- the viewer's selected accounts, re-derived by the holdings route's projection and never inherited from the firm's publication. Actual means SECURITY nodes of basis OBSERVED or ASSIGNED; a TARGET node is a model's intended split, not a holding, and never enters (the three bases are never spliced into one number). A security node with no security_id is never merged by name and stays its own item. OPTIONAL by the v1 immutability rule -- a v1 document that predates it stays valid.

class_totals_remainder.description: ADDITIVE, OPTIONAL (CTO DECISION 103025, walk-2 state table row W2-15). It is a different state from the class 'unclassified' (a position exists, its class is not known) and has a different remedy, so it is its own block and never a class_totals item. Served whenever class_totals is, with value 0 when every custody dollar reaches a position; class_totals plus this amount equals custody_totals.total_market_value. OPTIONAL by the v1 immutability rule -- a v1 document that predates it stays valid.
